title: ArmContext
description: Minimal context supplied to the arm/fire gates for a watchlist trigger. Intentionally small and additively versionable: new fields are appended as optional. Reference: docs/plans/PLAN-watchlist-trigger.html.

et_date.description: ET calendar date the gate is evaluating against (YYYY-MM-DD). Named et_date (not date) to avoid shadowing the date type in generated models.

cash.description: Optional broker account live CASH balance (dollars) available for sizing. Absent when the gate runs without an account snapshot.
